title: fix(app-shell): Studio Access refuses a new permission set over a taken identifier and can discard a set's draft
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbY2VZCDU1LZxstSD9mUKVAR)_

Fixes #26836

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:Studio「访问」页新建权限集前,先查已发布和草稿中的同名权限集(跨所有软件包);标识已被占用就拒绝、不写入,提示里点名那个权限集,属于本软件包时给出「打开它」。另外,打开的权限集若有待发布草稿,标题栏多一个「放弃草稿」。
- **为什么改**:原来的首写保护(`If-None-Match: *` + 草稿模式)只拦已有草稿,不拦已发布的同名权限集,于是新建会在线上权限集上叠一份空白草稿,发布软件包就会清空它的全部授权;Studio 里也没有办法放弃这份草稿。
- **风险与回滚**:低。只改 `AccessPillar` 一处的新建与放弃路径,沿用现有接口(列表、草稿列表、`DELETE ?state=draft&package=`);服务端、spec 不动。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 的 `AccessPillar`(`doCreate` 新增的占用检查、`discardDraft`、对话框 `extra` 里的拒绝提示);`StudioDesignSurface.accessCreateTaken-26836.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.accessCreateTaken-26836.test.tsx`,预期 9 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Create over a taken identifier is refused before anything is written.** `AccessPillar`'s `doCreate` now reads the published permission sets and the draft headers across every package (`client.list('permission')`, `client.listDrafts({ type: 'permission' })`, the same unscoped pair the Interfaces pillar's create reads). A name either holds is refused in the dialog with a sentence naming the set (its label and identifier). When the set is this package's (on the rail), the dialog offers "Open “LABEL”", which closes the dialog and opens it; a set another package holds gets no open path, and the sentence says it is outside this package.
- **A fresh name is created as before**: the draft save with `mode: 'draft'`, `packageId`, `ifNoneMatch: '*'`, `surface: 'studio'`, the toast, and the new set opened.
- **Discard draft.** An open set with a pending draft shows "Discard draft" in its header (beside Explain access), hidden on a read-only package. It confirms (one sentence for a published set, another for a set never published), then calls `client.reset('permission', NAME, { state: 'draft', packageId })`, the `DELETE ?state=draft&package=` door the metadata editor's discard uses. A published set goes back to its live body (the matrix re-reads it, as after a publish); a set never published leaves the rail. A refused discard is a toast with the door's message.
- Six new `studio` namespace rows in `@object-ui/i18n`, `en` and `zh`. One root changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch and `@object-ui/i18n` patch.
- No `packages/spec/**`, no server change.

## Tests

`StudioDesignSurface.accessCreateTaken-26836.test.tsx`, nine cases on the real `AccessPillar` and `PermissionMatrixEditPage`, over a client double that keeps published and draft rows per package and refuses a first-write pin over a draft row the way the door does:

- create over a published id of this package: refused, `save` never called, no draft row, the sentence names the set, and "Open" opens it (its header and grant count);
- create over a published id another package holds: refused, nothing written, no "Open";
- create over a draft id: refused before the save;
- a draft that lands between the check and the save: the save still carries `ifNoneMatch: '*'` and the door's 409 is shown, the other draft untouched (objectui#11773);
- a fresh id: saved with the four options above, toast, rail row and header;
- discard on a published set: `reset` called with `{ state: 'draft', packageId }`, the matrix goes from 0 to 1 object granted (the live set), the set stays on the rail, the control goes away;
- discard on a set never published: it leaves the rail and the remaining set opens;
- a declined confirm discards nothing;
- no discard control without a pending draft, nor on a read-only package.

## Acceptance notes

- **The door half is not a server defect, so there is no `domain:server` child.** The metadata door does what the spec declares: `SaveMetaItemRequestSchema.parentVersion` says a present `null` "asserts 'no current row of this lifecycle'" (on the REST door, `If-None-Match: *`), and the `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` changelog entry that opened the header says `If-None-Match: *` "with `?mode=draft` for a draft … saves only where no row of that lifecycle exists". A draft-mode pin over a published row is therefore admitted by contract (it is how a client says "start a draft only if nobody has one"). Making the door judge every lifecycle would be a semantic change to that declared pin, beyond this card.
- **Race window of the client-side check:** a set published (or created in another package) between the pillar's two reads and its save is not refused by the pin; the save then writes a blank draft over it, as before this change. A draft that lands in that window is still refused by the door (tested above).
- The "Open" path exists only for a set on this package's rail; a set another package holds cannot be opened from this pillar, so the refusal there names it and asks for another identifier.
